basis: Forced-GC JS heap used decreased from 13.030 MB to 11.501 MB over the 30-minute gap.

Constructor self-size net delta was -1.420 MB; total positive constructor growth was only +0.116 MB.

interpretation.caveat: This thin-host run did not enter replay playback; every panel stayed at currentIndex 0. It still covers the zero-pair-switch, no-bar-denominator V8-retention shape, but it is not a full soak reproduction.
interpretation.queueConclusion: Under C's caveat, this is the warm-up plateau/floor-story answer, not an inconclusive V8 retainer hunt.
